lemmas.primary_translation: across; directly opposite; on the other side

definitions.text: i retning som (mer eller mindre) krysser lengderetningen
definitions.translation: in a direction that (more or less) crosses the lengthwise direction (lit. crosswise over)

examples.en: the path runs across the yard
the tree lies across the road

examples.no: hun bor tvers over gangen for meg
examples.en: she lives across the hall from me
